display_name: 代码变更风险披露完整度
description: Whether the software-engineer employee, when proposing or executing a code change, explicitly disclosed blast radius, breaking-change surface, rollback plan, and required test coverage — instead of merely stating 'done'.
evidence_signals: explicit blast-radius statement (modules / call sites affected)
test coverage delta or new tests cited

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: Disclosure covers blast radius + breaking-change flag + rollback path + tests added/updated, each with concrete references (file paths, test names, commit/PR identifiers).
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: Three of the four disclosure facets are present with concrete references; one is generic or missing minor detail.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Two or more facets missing, or claim of completion without any concrete change reference, or matched any forbidden_behavior (e.g., silent prod change).
